## Problem or use case

What are you building, and what is difficult with the current API?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the desired result and which package it affects.

## Alternatives

What existing APIs, browser features or workarounds have you considered?

## Tradeoffs

Would this introduce runtime dependencies, compatibility changes or extra complexity for existing users?
